purpose: one deterministic evidence-maturity standard across specialized research without replacing domain methodology

states.PASS: all required sources and deterministic domain checks pass; downstream research use may proceed subject to its own authority gates
states.REVIEW_REQUIRED: no hard failure, but partial, intraday, thin, capped or otherwise qualified evidence requires specialist adjudication
states.BLOCKED: required evidence, freshness, provenance, arithmetic, mapping, quality, account context or domain methodology failed

required: fundamental and event evidence appropriate to the instrument
passing or explicitly qualified governing Watch validation
explicit RS level, slope and state
exact covered-universe breadth with coverage disclosure
sector.breadth_universe_label: covered screener membership; never official ETF constituents unless sourced as such

required: explicit one-month relative level and one-week relative direction
domain stock or instrument quality result
defense.nonpassing_cards: retained for audit but withheld from recommendation-eligible groups
